name: EPSY 5310
title: Facilitating Career Development
description: Provides students with relevant skills and knowledge to assist others in planning careers and obtaining meaningful work. Follows the National Career Development Association’s Career Services Provider (CSP) certification process. This 120-hour course is in a distance learning format. Students who successfully complete the course requirements may apply for the Global Career Development Facilitator Certificate.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
